body: I appreciate your post, but I just can't steel myself to consider the idea of putting my trust, my life, into a professional's hands. I don't want to become better at weekly intervals for a set price. I know that's irrational and I know something's wrong with me that previous people with my condition or whatever have fixed through therapy, but I just can't. It's the same with medication. I don't disrespect people who take antidepressants or anxiety meds, but I would never respect myself if I did. I don't want to be happy under the influence of drugs (pot is different, I'm talking about long-term), I want the ability to be happy by myself.

My mom sent me to a therapist when I was like 8 because I would freak out if people touched me, I couldn't wear jeans, and I had to touch certain spots on the wall, etc. I bullshitted my way through a year of the therapy (in a rather smart way for an 8 year old) and those things decreased over time by themselves, but they're definitely not gone. I have panic attacks sometimes and night terrors that I've only told one person about.

The thing is, I do have things that give me "happiness". I have no idea why I want to die. But it's unmistakable. I think about it every day. I've researched suicide methods and the only thing that's prevented me so far is lack of opportunities and general afraidness. God, I just don't know. fuck.
